_doc: Weekly macro digest config. One card + one chart per indicator. NAPM (ISM PMI) and WILL5000IND were retired from FRED due to licensing disputes — replaced with INDPRO (Industrial Production) and ^GSPC (S&P 500). Buffett Indicator divides total corporate equity market value by GDP. numeratorSources is an ordered fallback list: the first entry whose every series resolves is used, so the nonfinancial-only series still covers us if the financial-sector leg fails. Z.1 equity series are published in MILLIONS of dollars while GDP is in BILLIONS, hence scale. Capex comes from SEC EDGAR XBRL for every company with a `cik`; `estimatedCapex` is only a fallback used when EDGAR has no usable XBRL yet, so a company switches from estimate to filed data automatically the quarter its first 10-Q lands — adding a CIK is the only edit needed.
